title: Projection formula, finite coefficients
statement:
Let $\Lambda=A_{E,n}$, let $f:X\to Y$ be separated of finite type, and let
$K$ and $L$ be bounded constructible complexes on the small étale sites with
$L$ of finite Tor amplitude, so that $K\in\Dbc(X,\Lambda)$ and
$L\in\Dctf(Y,\Lambda)$. Then $\operatorname{PF}_{f,K,L}$ is an isomorphism in
$D^+(Y_{\Et},\Lambda)$, natural in $K$ and $L$.

proof.text: The coefficient ring A_(E,n) is finite by Padic.finite_coefficientExtensionRing and therefore IsAddTorsion by isAddTorsion_of_finite. Apply the existing unbounded torsion-ring proper projection theorem isIso_rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap_of_isProper to the proper factor c.g. The existing hasProjectionFormulaOfCompactification_of_isIso assembles the open comparison with this proper projection: its component is this proper projection followed by proper pushforward of the inverse open-extension tensor comparison and the pullback-composition comparison. Both later factors are already canonical isomorphisms, so the specified projection component is invertible. This uses the existing geometric-fibre proper projection argument as a tool, rather than repeating its stalk calculation and finite-free devissage.

The lower cohomology bound in hKb and DerivedCategory.isGE_iff give K in degrees at least k. Exact open extension preserves this bound by Functor.isGE_mapDerivedCategory_obj. The right derived direct image preserves it by Functor.isGE_rightDerivedFunctor_obj. Their composition is the chosen rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification, hence Rf!K has the same lower bound. No Noetherian or constructibility hypothesis is required.

Convert the recorded hasTorAmplitudeIn hypothesis of L to the generic torAmplitudeIn with hasTorAmplitudeIn_iff_torAmplitudeIn. Choose a lower bound d for Rf!K from the preceding step and the Tor interval [a,b] of L. DerivedCategory.isGE_tensor_of_torAmplitudeIn gives L tensor Rf!K in degrees at least a+d. The derived braiding transports this bound to Rf!K tensor L, which is the source of the specified projection. Finally ObjectProperty.prop_of_iso transports D+ membership along the actual projection isomorphism to its target. Combine the two memberships and IsIso as the stated conjunction. The bifunctor transformation supplies naturality, and fullness of D+ includes the inverse.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q118-609b7e3c0 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item, unit, chapter and the main-20261015 statement and proof in full, together with Stacks 0F0C, 0F0G and 0944 at their labels and the statements and blueprint updates of all 24 proof_deps and 8 stmt_deps. The statement is verbatim the source and is not weakened: small étale sites, finite Tor amplitude only on L, PF in D^+(Y_Et). The proof stays étale; dropping the pro-étale sk-def-sf-operations citation is correct. S1: π is the counit map of def-kun-projection-formula-map. σ is built on a K-flat Q with flat terms, and j^{-1}Q stays K-flat by the pullback lemma, since u^*=u^{-1}; descent via lem-weil-pbc-site-derived-tensor-descent. S2: stalks are the identity on U and 0 off U, and conservativity is applied to the cohomology sheaves. S3: the small-étale clause of fix-lem-finite-tor-perfect matches the hypotheses, and sheaves on Spec Ω are naturally constant. The source error is valid but harmless: Z/ℓ over Z/ℓ² is not perfect, and the proof only needs P=L_ȳ. S4: a finite ring is torsion. Unbounded proper base change applies to p for M and M⊗p^{-1}L, and lem-kun-proj-formula-natural relates the actual PF maps through the same Ex. S5: the projection-mate lemma gives exactness, shifts, the connecting square and α_Λ=1. I checked the truncation by hand: T=F^b[-b] is a subcomplex, the splitting identities hold and δ^{b-1}=d^{b-1}; the induction runs on the number of nonzero terms from 0. S6: the cone is acyclic by stalks, the inverse is in the correct order, D^+ is strictly full, and naturality holds. No new nodes; proof_deps equals the union of the step uses; no cycle; no SGA citation. Not duplicates: lem-weil-finite-compact-projection-formula and thm-sf-pf-finite add the finite-field datum, and lem-sf-projection-finite-constant states something else. I accept all 18 declared tool uses as generic. Edge cases: ∅, K or L zero, F=0, gaps, n=1 and n>1 with infinite global dimension. Inherited caveat, not a fault: sk-def-sf-exchanges is typed through pro-étale notation, while the étale composite comes from the unit's own step 1. The maintainer tool_uses field still lists the uncited lem-cbc-extension-zero-base-change. No fixes.
